notes.title: New update! New Youtubers+Streamers video! And a free key giveaway!
notes.content:
[h1]A new patch is available on Steam!![/h1]

It includes:
🙈Pic of the winner of the cartridge contest is now on a mag cover!
🙊Small final boss level design tweaks
🙉Audio fixes in intro+final levels

Also thanks to our awesome colleague Julia, we offer your this hilarious [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TJ8Dn2A2Pcs]Youtubers and Streamers tribute compilation video[/url] and invite everybody to send us your Pixel Ripped 1989 videos (hello-at-pixelripped-dot-com) if you want to be considered for future compilations! everybody who participates will have the chance of winning a game key!

And, last but not least we are running a 3 keys #giveaway on gleam.io, check it out here:

gleam. io/EF2iH/pixel-ripped-key-giveaway

Also, we created a [url=https://discord.gg/nxc348W]Discord server![/url] Join us there to discuss anything related to the game and to VR technology!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/577530/]

[/url]
